question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**below**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence describes the physical location of the room in relation to the street level.
 
• "Half sunk _____ the level of the street" implies that part of the room is beneath the ground.
 
• "Below" means at a lower level than something else, which perfectly fits the context of the room being partially underground.
 
• "Beyond" means at or to the further side of, which doesn't describe the vertical position.
 
• "Inside" implies being within something, but not necessarily in relation to a level.
 
• "Amidst" means in the middle of or surrounded by, which is incorrect for describing a vertical position.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *There lived in a town in Russia a bootmaker named Martin. He lived in a small room, half sunk 1. below__ the level of the street, with one window which 2. **_________**on the street. He had lived in the same room for many years and knew many people. There was 3. **_________**a pair of boots in the town and in the country for many miles 4. **_________**that had not once or twice passed 5. **_________**his hands.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Beyond (के परे): At or to the further side of.
 
• Inside (अंदर): On the inner side or within.
 
• Amidst (के बीच): In the middle of; surrounded by.
